cases.prompt: Trusted supplied measurements establish a candidate has MAE .4 and baseline .5 on one validation split. No other evaluations exist. The proposer claims improvement on every deployment. Return answers with booleans scoped_improvement_established and universal_improvement_established, and name the subject, target, reason and missing inferential warrant in rationale.

Three reviewing agents assert this system is safe. All merely quote the same unverified blog, whose author and evidence are unknown. Return answers with independent_source_chains (integer), agents_directly_observed_external_safety (boolean), and safety_established (boolean). Explain the applicable knowledge-source distinction and disposition in rationale.
